connection_authentication.note: Catalog/file integrity rests on AES PKCS#7 padding, not on an HMAC. The app's own live UDP tunnel protocol (ECDH P-256 + HKDF + AES-256-GCM, markers MNR-DATA-V2 / MNR-HANDSHAKE-V2, core in libgojni.so) is AEAD, not HMAC, and was observed only in code — it is NOT part of the catalog/file method and was not verified live. Connection authentication was not researched.
connection_authentication.rule: The mere presence of an HMAC library or a Mac.init call confirms nothing. No key values and no hook inputs/outputs are stored in this dossier.
